messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — Vergent Labs renewal coming up next week. onboarding was delayed ~6 weeks so they asked to shorten to a 9mo term and request a credit. can we align on approach?
Jake Patel: Thanks Maria. they used hosted, low usage. asking for 9mo + pro rated. CS asked for a goodwill credit to offset ramp. I think finance + legal need to ok before I confirm.
Maria Chen: They also need a PO and vendor code on the invoice, and their procurement requires KMS integration proof (customer-managed keys) before processing payment.
Lucas Reed (Billing): PO + vendor code fine. vendor code field: V-LABS-001. For invoice split, do they want one invoice split across entities or two invoices?
Maria Chen: Two invoices — one to Vergent Labs US, one to Vergent Labs EU. split % is 70/30.
Lucas Reed (Billing): Ok noted. I'll need tax IDs for both entities and the vendor code. Sarah, legal — do we have any red flags on KMS statement?
Sarah Gomez (Legal): KMS request is common. Need to confirm they just want key wrap/transfer for logs or full envelope keys. we require an MSA addendum for customer-managed keys + SOC attestation checkbox. I can sketch language but need them to accept the addendum.
Jake Patel: Is that something we can include as a short amendment to the renewal? want to avoid delaying signature.
Priya Nair (Solutions): Also requested a short enablement session post-sign to finish integration — said the delay hurt their rollout. we should offer a 1-hr enablement + one follow-up office hour. good to capture feedback too.
Maria Chen: Proposed commercial: 9mo term, list price prorated, $2k credit for onboarding delay, 70/30 invoice split, addendum for KMS acceptance. Jake — can you confirm if AE approves credit?
Jake Patel: I can approve up to $2k for this ARR band. :thumbsup: I'll send updated SOW.
Maria Chen: I'll prep the DocuSign but holding until legal signs off on the addendum. Lucas — can you draft two invoices placeholders and include vendor code V-LABS-001?
Lucas Reed (Billing): On it. Drafting now. ETA 2 hours.
Sarah Gomez (Legal): Draft addendum here:```
- Customer will provide KMS public key and attest to control of private key.
- Redwood will not export customer private keys.
- Limited liability carveout applied to key misuse causes.
```
Sarah Gomez (Legal): Need customer contact name for KMS signer and the tax IDs.
Maria Chen: Contact is Emma Ortiz (emma.ortiz@vergent.com). I'll collect tax IDs and confirm KMS signer.
Priya Nair (Solutions): For enablement feedback capture: I'll run a 5-question survey after session and flag any product gaps. want to include a short blurb in the SOW.
Jake Patel: Sending updated SOW + PO sample. sample PO snippet:```
PO: 987654-VG
Bill To: Vergent Labs US (TIN: 12-3456789)
Amount: $24,000 (9mo)
Vendor Code: V-LABS-001
Invoice split: 70% US / 30% EU (see entity EU TIN on file)
```
Maria Chen: Perfect. After legal OKs addendum I'll route DocuSign. If anything blocks sign tomorrow ping me.
deploy-bot: reminder: renewal date in 7 days for Vergent Labs — status: awaiting legal addendum acceptance.
Jake Patel: Thanks team — I'll loop with Emma and push for PO + signed addendum today.
Maria Chen: Great. I'll update the renewal tracker and add enablement session as contingent deliverable.
Priya Nair (Solutions): I'll draft the 5-question feedback survey and share link once session is scheduled.
Lucas Reed (Billing): Draft invoices uploaded to the billing queue. tagging @Maria Chen for final review.
Maria Chen: Reviewed. all good. closing loop — will post final once signed. :white_check_mark:
